artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a smooth uniformly convex (real) Banach space. Recall the following definitions:

- A nonempty subset $C \subseteq X$ is called a *Chebyshev set* if for every $x \in X$ there exists a unique point $P_C(x) \in C$ such that $\|x - P_C(x)\| = d(x, C) := \inf_{y \in C}\|x - y\|$.
- A nonempty subset $C \subseteq X$ is called *approximatively compact* if for every $x \in X$ and every minimizing sequence $(y_n) \subseteq C$ (i.e. $\|x - y_n\| \to d(x, C)$), the sequence $(y_n)$ has a subsequence converging in norm to a point of $C$.
- $X$ is *uniformly convex* if for every $\varepsilon \in (0, 2]$ there exists $\delta > 0$ such that whenever $\|x\| = \|y\| = 1$ and $\|x - y\| \geq \varepsilon$, one has $\|(x+y)/2\| \leq 1 - \delta$.
- $X$ is *smooth* if at every nonzero point of $X$ the norm has a unique supporting hyperplane (equivalently, the norm is Gâteaux differentiable on $X \setminus \{0\}$).

Question: Must every Chebyshev set in $X$ be approximatively compact?
artifact.status_search_result: The classical question of whether every Chebyshev set in a smooth uniformly convex Banach space (in particular, in an infinite-dimensional Hilbert space) is convex remains a well-known open problem, and it is known to be equivalent to the question of whether every such Chebyshev set is approximatively compact. Surveys and encyclopedia entries on Chebyshev sets continue to list these as open, with only partial results (e.g. local compactness or weak closedness implies convexity). No resolution in the general smooth uniformly convex Banach space setting has been reported.

status_evidence.title: Chebyshev set - Encyclopedia of Mathematics
status_evidence.snippet: In a uniformly convex and smooth Banach space, any locally compact Chebyshev set is convex; the general question remains open.
status_evidence.claim: The convexity (and equivalently the approximative compactness) of Chebyshev sets in smooth uniformly convex Banach spaces is still an open problem in general.

status_evidence.title: A look at proximinal and Chebyshev sets in Banach spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses long-standing open questions about Chebyshev sets in Hilbert and uniformly convex spaces, including their approximative compactness and convexity.
status_evidence.claim: Recent surveys list the question of approximative compactness/convexity of Chebyshev sets in smooth uniformly convex Banach spaces as still open.
